The '''Osaji family''' was a family of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] that ran the [[Osaji Syndicate]]. It was lead by [[Osaji Shimka]], and after [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Death/Legends|assassination]] by his three children, the triplets [[Osaji Verane]], [[Osaji Uhares]] and [[Osaji Hux]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Hux hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to kill her two siblings.
